preconditions.description: The length of the original string s is at least 1 and at most 500000.
The length of the desired string is at least 1 and at most 500000.
The original string s has a length exactly equal to n.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The original string s consists of lowercase English letters only.

postconditions.description: The output string has a length exactly equal to k.
The output string is lexicographically the smallest among all possible strings of length k that can be obtained by the given operations on s.
